_comment: rag+chat lane — mid-to-heavy reasoning. Collapsed from the proposal's separate rag/chat drafts (owner direction 2026-07-19: they were identical anyway; split them again later if rag and chat ever need independent tuning). Mirrors litellm-config.yaml's glm-5.1-primary / NVIDIA-backup pattern, with the Gemini 4-key rotation slotted in as a middle tier that absorbs rate-limit overflow before falling all the way to NVIDIA. Middle tier pinned to 'gemini-flash-latest', NOT 'gemini-2.5-pro': live verification 2026-07-19 found every one of the 4 keys 429'd ('exceeded current quota') on gemini-2.5-pro/gemini-pro-latest under test traffic, while gemini-flash-latest returned 200 for all keys tested. Revisit the pro tier once real usage patterns show whether that 429 was rapid-test-traffic-induced or a standing free-tier cap — see docker/gateway/portkey/README.md.
